register.labelZh: LIVE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: live by、live off 和 live on 可以說明某人靠一項活動賺錢、依靠別人供養,或靠某筆收入生活。；live in、live out 和 live with 可以說明某人住在工作地點、住在外面,或與另一個人同住。；live by 可以描述奉行的原則;live for 可以表示生命中最重要的事;live with 則可以描述接受不理想的情況。；live through、live out、live on、live something down 和 live up to 可以用來談論重大經歷、夢想、回憶、尷尬事情和期望。
register.summaryEn: Live by, live off and live on help you explain whether someone earns money through an activity, depends on another person or manages with a particular income. Live in, live out and live with help you explain whether someone stays at a workplace, lives elsewhere or shares a home with another person. Live by describes a guiding principle, live for shows what matters most to someone, and live with describes accepting something unpleasant. Live through, live out, live on, live something down and live up to help you discuss major experiences, dreams, memories, embarrassment and expectations.
contextsZh: 清楚說明人們如何維持生活
談論原則、人生重心和困難現實
描述重要經歷和長遠影響
contextsEn: Talk clearly about how people support themselves
Talk about values, purpose and difficult realities
Describe important experiences and lasting effects

fixedVariable.variableZh: 保留原句中的人物、事物、時間和意思。；live on、live off、live out 和 live with 可以表達不同意思。請仔細留意句子中關於金錢、食物、住宿和個人處境的資料。；使用 it 或 them 時,請按照以上例子放置。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. Live on, live off, live out and live with can express different ideas. Read the details about money, food, accommodation and personal situations carefully. Follow these model positions when using it or them: live it out · live it down · live with it
